title: Northlight Brief & Decision Sprint
topics: Product roadmap decisions (hosted vs private focus)
summary: Leadership reviewed Q1 metrics and proposed a small pivot to prioritize Dedicated capacity optimizations over new feature launches
There was a candid discussion about a recent P0 incident impacting KV cache invalidation and the operational actions required
Headcount plan adjusted: hiring freeze on some IC roles, targeted senior hires for infra and security
People team to roll out updated compensation transparency notes and a manager forum next week
Clear next steps: reforecast budget, schedule technical deep dive for infra team, update product roadmap and communicate to customers
action_items: Samir Patel - run root-cause follow-up doc for KV cache incident and share by 2026-02-24
Priya Das - reprioritize roadmap card list and publish revised timeline by 2026-02-27
Lena Ortiz - publish manager Q&A and comp transparency summary by 2026-02-25
Mark Rios - schedule Dedicated capacity perf deep dive with SEs and infra by 2026-02-26
next_steps: Reforecast budget with 4% runway buffer (Finance + CEO)
Host infra deep-dive and invite customer-facing SEs
Communicate roadmap pivot in weekly product update
Open a hiring intake for 2 senior infra engineers only
transcript: Meeting header: 2026-02-20 10:00 PST — 72 minutes — 'Northlight Brief & Decision Sprint' — Host: Elena Park
[00:00] Elena: Hi everyone, thanks for joining on time, we're gonna run a tighter sprint today — updates and decisions, not a fireside, okay?
[00:30] Mark: Quick context, infra had a splice over the weekend,K V cache invalidation triggered a P0 that we mitigated, but the latency tail spiked for about 22 minutes, not great
[01:05] Priya: Right, customer tickets escalated on the Redwood hosted API side, a few customers saw timeouts which then bubbled to AE and CSM teams
[01:30] Elena: We need the RCA and an action plan on the table before next Tues, Samir, can you own that?
[01:45] Samir: Yep, I'll lead it. There's some fuzz in the telemetry so it might read like the K V cache was OK but the routing layer retried — can't be 100% yet
[02:20] Lena: on the people side, folks are anxious, I had a couple of managers ask about hiring pause rumors — we should be clear
[02:45] Elena: We'll be transparent. We are pausing a handful of open junior IC requisitions and holding for senior infra/security roles — it's about runway and risk
[03:10] Mark: Technical note: we've got three potential mitigations — increase prefix caching time, add a short-circuit for KV hot keys, or route to Dedicated pool in overflow
[03:40] Priya: Routing to Dedicated as fallback has product implications and cost tradeoffs, customers will need to opt in or we'll trigger pricing concerns
[04:05] Speaker 1: (murmur) hmm —
[04:20] Elena: Let's capture options now then prioritize, we don't need a perfect solution this week, just a safe stop-gap and a path to a proper fix
[05:00] Samir: plan: immediate revert to stable kernel for affected model family, mitigations for hot-key, and telemetry upgrade — I'll write the doc
[05:30] Priya: On roadmap — given this incident and our Q1 metrics, proposal is to pull forward two infra-focused bets from Q3 to Q2: dedicated capacity perf work and KV cache resilience
[06:05] Mark: That means delaying some UX polish items and a new analytics dashboard; I want to be explicit about what we deprioritize
[06:40] Elena: Agree. We need clear messaging to customers and the commercial teams. AE/CSM, you'll get the short note tonight
[07:10] Lena: People implications — we'll freeze hiring for junior roles and re-open for senior infra/security — compensation band review will continue
[07:40] Priya: There's a customer ask (large fintech) pushing for private deployment and on-prem guarantees — this incident strengthens that ask
[08:05] Mark: We should accelerate the private deployment hardening path; it's green for compliance but needs perf work
[08:45] Elena: Finance input — runway is okay but thin, we should reforecast with a conservative 4% buffer and tighten discretionary spend
[09:20] Speaker 2: (inaudible) question about quotas?
[09:35] Priya: Quotas/limits are fine, but we need to make default route policy explicit in the API docs so customers aren't surprised when we route to a fall-back model
[10:05] Mark: Also tooling — tracing for request routing needs more fidelity; our current traces drop on heavy tail which made debugging harder
[10:45] Elena: Ok, decision time for this meeting: pivot roadmap to infra-first for next 6 weeks? thumbs up/down
[11:10] (multiple chimes/virtual raised hands) consensus leans yes
[11:35] Elena: Specific decisions: 1) Pause low-priority UX work; 2) Launch KV cache resilience sprint; 3) Re-open senior infra hiring intake — accepted
[12:00] Samir: I'll assemble the RCA skeleton now and set a 48h checkpoint, will share with leadership and on-call
[12:25] Priya: Product will communicate a one-paragraph note to customers, with a link to incident page and mitigation steps — we should avoid overpromise
[12:50] Elena: Good. People team, what do we need to do for morale and manager questions?
[13:10] Lena: Manager forum tomorrow, and we'll publish comp transparency notes, plus office hours for ICs who have questions
[13:35] Speaker 3: I'm worried about churn if we keep pausing hiring —
[13:50] Elena: We'll be targeted and transparent; senior roles continue and we will backfill critical gaps quickly
[14:10] Mark: On metrics — brief readout: P0 frequency YTD is slightly above our target, but median latency still within SLO, it's the tail we must fix
[14:40] Priya: Shipping schedule change: move 'Analytics Dashboard' to Q3, move 'Dedicated latency optimization' to Q2
[15:05] Speaker 4: (off mic) any changes to compliance timelines?
[15:20] Mark: Compliance timeline remains, SOC2 audit in April still on track, Private deployment package needs more perf testing but we keep the target
[15:50] Elena: Finance will reconvene and we'll publish a reforecast by Friday, include hiring constraints and runway implications
[16:10] Samir: Quick note — the KV cache incident had three contributing factors: kernel bump, a regression in our batching algo, and a telemetry gap
[16:40] Priya: We need an incident follow-up ticket pool prioritized by customer impact, not just severity score
[17:05] Elena: Good call. Marketing/Comms: don't over-scrub the message, be factual and provide timelines
[17:30] Lena: Also roll out manager Q&A template so managers get consistent answers when questions arise
[17:55] Mark: Can we set a hard SLO for tail latency and tie recycling to autoscaling rules? it's doable but needs infra cycles
[18:20] Priya: We'll schedule an engineering prioritization session later today to map tradeoffs
[18:45] Elena: Anything else? open floor
[19:00] Speaker 5: recommend we surface the Dedicated fallback policy doc to customers as beta
[19:20] Priya: Yes, will draft a beta doc and coordinate with legal for correct wording
[19:45] Elena: All right, quick recap: Samir RCA by 24th, Priya roadmap by 27th, Lena comms by 25th, Mark infra deep-dive by 26th. Finance reforecast by Friday. Any objections?
[20:10] (silence)
[20:20] Elena: Great. We'll keep this short — thank you everyone, meeting adjourned
[20:35] (meeting ends)
